https://github.com/arthrod/premirror
29b78634d6496206c84015068eb7d66d9cdc312c

Local integration changes:
- Workspace package manifests use npm-compatible internal 0.1.0 dependencies; dev-only packages omitted.
- TypeScript pretext-stub path aliases removed. Production uses real @chenglou/pretext 0.0.5.
- Composer's character-fitting loop advances by Intl.Segmenter grapheme boundaries (code-point fallback), so combining marks and joined emoji stay together in supported modern browsers.
- Composer's isWordChar reads Unicode letters, digits and marks (not only ASCII), so a line never ends inside an accented word; scripts that break between characters stay breakable.
- Composer applies kinsoku when it picks a break: closing punctuation (。」、 …) never starts a line, an opening bracket (「（ …) never ends one (NO_LINE_START / NO_LINE_END).
- Composer breaks each line of a block at the width of its own slot (the band at that line's y), not the first line's, so first-line and hanging obstacles narrow only their lines.
- Other runtime source retained from the pinned arthrod commit.

Security maintenance (2026-10-14): composer and adapter pretext dependencies are pinned to patched 0.0.5; upstream source revision is unchanged. See https://github.com/chenglou/pretext/security/advisories/GHSA-5478-66c3-rhxr.
